text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...If it's only this much, there shouldn't 
be any problem.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't even qualify as a minor injury. 
Running shouldn't be an issue at all.
choice_data_list: Let's make sure to rest properly, though.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Why...? If you get hurt, licking your 
wounds is supposed to heal them, right?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Back in my hometown, stuff like this was 
just everyday life anyway.
choice_data_list: Because it might affect things later on.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... I see. Understood. It would be 
troublesome if I couldn't run in races.

After finishing the treatment, I decided 
to have her rest for the day.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Back when I ran in the forest, 
injuries like this were nothing unusual...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No... the pain is still bothering me a bit 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Starting to care about things that never 
used to bother you might be a bad sign.

After finishing the treatment, I decided 
to have her rest for the day.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Well, if you asked me to jump across a 
cliff right now, that might be a bit 
tough, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"No, I used to do voluntary training like 
that back in the day. If that's not it, 
then no problem."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's do it one more time. 
Trainer.

After finishing the treatment, I decided 
to resume training at Oguri Cap's request.
